title: Split Logs and Sacks of Wheat
summary: Two loads wait in Oakvale: split logs for Tuck Shaw and sacks of wheat for Dorrit Merrow. Eorl Seedley wants them moved before the rain turns the lane to soup.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Tuck Shaw waits on split logs and Dorrit Merrow on sacks of wheat. Fetch them in any order, before the rain turns the lane to soup."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 4 split logs from the great oak
Take 4 sacks of wheat from the second stack
Hand the split logs to Tuck Shaw
Hand the sacks of wheat to Dorrit Merrow
Tell Eorl Seedley both are in
